business_problem: Turtle Bay Resort could not easily segment guests or personalize excursion recommendations because booking, behavior, and preference data were fragmented, and concierge staff spent too much time answering repeat questions manually.
solution_summary: Turtle Bay Resort uses Data Cloud, Einstein 1 Marketing, Marketing Cloud Personalization, and Einstein 1 Service to tailor both guest outreach and on-property support around a unified guest profile. Data Cloud consolidates booking history, stated preferences, and resort interactions so the resort can instantly build segments such as adventurous couples or families looking for different activities. Einstein 1 Marketing then turns those segments into targeted campaigns, while Marketing Cloud Personalization and a partner-built propensity model surface the most relevant excursion or luxury offers in the resort's digital guest experience. On the service side, Einstein 1 Service uses the resort's knowledge base to draft accurate concierge responses for dining, transportation, room, and activity questions, which lets staff reply faster while preserving a high-touch hospitality experience.
data_flow: Guest bookings, preferences, and activity interactions are unified in Data Cloud, segmented for campaigns and web personalization, and then reused by concierge staff through Einstein 1 Service so both digital recommendations and human responses reflect the same guest context.
business_outcome: Turtle Bay Resort improved guest targeting and self-service, lifted adventure booking conversions and repeat bookings, raised web engagement, and made concierge support materially more efficient.
metrics: 15% rise in repeat bookings for adventure experiences
50% more efficient in providing guests with prompt, informative replies
architecture_clues: A custom propensity AI model identifies the excursions most likely to appeal to each guest.
Marketing and guest services teams use a custom guest console informed by unified profile data.
Concierge replies are grounded in the resort's knowledge base rather than freeform generation.
evidence_quotes: The resort also identifies guests who prefer luxury experiences and uses Einstein 1 Marketing to send them specialized email campaigns with exclusive adventure offers.
These targeted campaigns have led to a 20% increase in booking conversions and a 15% rise in repeat bookings for adventure experiences.
Personalized web content for known users has led to a 40% increase in user engagement.
The concierge service at Turtle Bay Resort uses Einstein 1 Service to quickly handle a wide range of guest questions.
